text.comments.ts: Selects added diff lines, comments on the selection and records the clipboard for the review comment specs
text.graph-harness.ts: Builds and manages isolated Electron graph fixtures for browser tests
text.tray-popover-harness.ts: Bundles the popover page and launches the hidden Electron popover harness at a chosen pixel density, finds its frame and lets a test open or update the popover with a model and read the calls it made
text.skills-extras-harness.ts: Builds and launches the Electron Skills window harness over a temporary home and a git project seeded with installed skills and extras files and, on request, a skills repo with a skill linker that is saved or only returned, resolving the import aliases in its bundles, and cleans them up
text.integrations-harness.ts: Builds and launches the Electron Integrations harness with git projects and a stub provider server, resolving the import aliases and loading svg icons as text in its bundles, and cleans them up
text.overflow.ts: Finds text cut off at a pane edge, in the Macro Overview drawer too, and ellipsised names that are squeezed or have no tooltip (a title or a data-tip)
text.overview.ts: Opens and closes the Macro Overview drawer, which holds the chips, legend and details of the picked block, so a spec can read or leave them
